title: Ashur-nadin-shumi
summary: Son of Sennacherib, made king of Babylon.
description: Son of Sennacherib. Griffith & White (Reply to Beckman, Part 2, Tables 2 and 3) date his elevation to the throne of Babylon to 700 BC. Person record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman (OSF project 5b64m) on 2026-11-13.

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (Tier 2, CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 700 BC). No tier 1–4 birth year.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, Table 3, row 700, p. 45; Table 2, row 700, p. 42
reign.note: Put on the throne of Babylon by his father Sennacherib.

free_source_links.locator: Table 3, row 700, p. 45; Table 2, row 700, p. 42
